verdict.rationale: Docs show each app has a dedicated MCP server with app-specific tool docs (e.g., ClickUp's tool/header list) and transport details (SSE/streamable HTTP) are documented generally, and a chat app lets developers try tools before integrating. However there's no evidence of a structured registry UI exposing full input schemas or explicit hosting attributes per server prior to connecting. Missing for 10: explicit input-schema inspection, per-server hosting/self-host vs managed disclosure, a unified discovery/registry browsing interface.
